findings.highlight: Arturia was made to wish for a battle she did not wish for
findings.evidenceJa: 望まぬ戦いを望まれたアルトリア
findings.governingReading: Arturia was called upon to fight wars she did not desire.
findings.explanation: The demand imposed on the king is reassigned as her contradictory wish.

findings.highlight: Every one of her twelve battles was severe, and this just happened to be the greatest wound appropriate for her end
findings.evidenceJa: 十二もの戦はそのどれもが身を[ruby text="さ"]削くような戦いであり、これは、その最後に相応しい、もっとも大きな傷痕
findings.governingReading: All twelve battles wore away at her body; this was the greatest scar, fitting for the last of them.
findings.explanation: The bodily image is flattened and unsupported chance is added to the culmination.

findings.highlight: The lone king, who tried to be a king until her last moments
findings.evidenceJa: 最期まで王として有り続けようとした独りの騎士
findings.governingReading: The lone knight who tried to remain king to the very end.
findings.explanation: The knight/king dual identity central to Saber’s characterization is collapsed.

findings.highlight: She looks so lovely that it doesn’t seem like she would be capable of fighting
findings.evidenceJa: 倒れれば立ち上がれそうにないほど可憐だと思う
findings.governingReading: She seems so delicate that, if she fell, she might never rise again.
findings.explanation: The ominous image of being unable to rise is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺にとってはあまりにも儚げに、彼女は笑った
findings.governingReading: To me, her smile looked unbearably fragile.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s subjective and extreme response becomes a neutral manner adverb.

findings.highlight: I want to be with you, Saber
findings.evidenceJa: 俺はもっと、ずっとセイバーと一緒にいたい
findings.governingReading: I want to be with you more—always.
findings.explanation: The comparative and continuing duration of Shirou’s wish disappear.
